description.value:
Frequency once per turn

Trigger A one-handed firearm you are wielding is emptied.

Reload the emptied weapon, or draw and ready a second one-handed firearm, at no action cost. If you are already wielding two firearms, you may instead swap which one counts as your primary hand for the rest of the turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: the free-reload/free-draw half alone would match, but the "swap which hand counts as primary" branch has no selector, so the card as a whole doesn't reduce to a clean SKIP. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. Pure action-cost-to-free conversion with no secondary numeric effect -- matches the pre-confirmed absence directly (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/barbarian/level-14/vengeful-strike.json and .../shared-class-feats/level-2/quick-draw.json, both rules: []).
